recipe.visualDefinition: A vibrant, eclectic composition featuring four women interacting with two bright blue public phone booths against a soft, cloud-like blue gradient background. The style is characterized by high-contrast studio lighting, saturated primary colors, and a playful, 'ransom note' style typographic header.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject interaction with props creating a central cluster
High-contrast subjects against a low-contrast, airy background
Eclectic, multi-font header balancing the structured central image
Repetition of blue tones across props and background
coreInvariants: Bright blue public phone booths as central props
Soft-focus blue and white gradient background
Playful, non-uniform typographic treatment at the top

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four women arranged around two central phone booths, occupying the middle and lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The two bright blue phone booths in the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the eclectic header, moves down through the faces of the women, and settles on the wide-tracked subtitle at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample soft blue space in the upper corners and around the central group to allow the busy typography to breathe.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cerulean blue (phone booths and background gradient)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Yellow, pink, and purple (typographic elements and accessories)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the foreground elements against a high-value, low-saturation background.

letterConstructionRules: Each character in the main title uses a different font, color, and background shape
Background shapes include rectangles, circles, and wavy banners
Subtitle uses a clean, wide-tracked serif
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters placed on contrasting color blocks
Integration of decorative patterns like dots or stripes within letter backgrounds
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between chaotic, colorful display type and clean, airy, wide-tracked serif body text.

preserve: Wide tracking for the bottom text

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the eclectic, non-uniform feel of the 90s header.
Matches the elegant, spaced-out serif at the bottom.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio shot of four women in 90s fashion (velvet, lace, patterned shirts) posing playfully around two bright blue public phone booths. The background is a soft, out-of-focus blue and white sky-like gradient. High-key lighting with vibrant saturation.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, eclectic title at the top using a mix of bold fonts, each letter on a different colored geometric shape. Add a small, white, wide-tracked serif subtitle at the bottom center.

verificationChecks: Is the header composed of multiple contrasting fonts and colors?
Are the phone booths a vibrant, saturated blue?
Is the bottom text extremely wide-tracked?
Is the background a soft blue gradient?

adjustableVariables: Specific colors of the typographic blocks
mustRedesign: Original brand logos on the phone booths
Exact wording of the original text
postGenerationChecks: Check for 'ransom note' style typographic variety in the header.
Ensure the blue of the phone booths pops against the background.
Verify the wide tracking of the lower text.
Confirm the playful, high-energy posing of the subjects.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [90s studio photography of a group with props] + [Eclectic multi-font collage header] + [Wide-tracked serif subtitle] + [Saturated primary color palette].
